modulos.descripcion: Vista general del rendimiento de ventas y pedidos

kpis.label: Ventas Totales
kpis.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS v FROM customer_orders
kpis.sub_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM customer_orders

kpis.label: Total Pedidos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM customer_orders

kpis.label: Ticket Promedio
kpis.sql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG("Total"), 0) AS v FROM customer_orders

kpis.label: Categoría Top
kpis.sql: SELECT "Product_Category" AS v FROM customer_orders WHERE "Product_Category" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Product_Category" ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) DESC LIMIT 1
kpis.sub_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS v FROM customer_orders WHERE "Product_Category" = (SELECT "Product_Category" FROM customer_orders WHERE "Product_Category" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Product_Category" ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) DESC LIMIT 1)

kpis.label: Sucursales Activas
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Branch") AS v FROM customer_orders

kpis.label: Unidades Vendidas
kpis.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("Quantity"), 0) AS v FROM customer_orders

graficos.sub: Total de ventas agrupado por sucursal
graficos.sql: SELECT "Branch" AS Branch, COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS Total FROM customer_orders WHERE "Branch" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Branch" ORDER BY Total DESC

graficos.sub: Participación de ventas por categoría de producto
graficos.sql: SELECT "Product_Category" AS Category, COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS Total FROM customer_orders WHERE "Product_Category" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Product_Category" ORDER BY Total DESC

graficos.sub: Comparación de ventas según tipo de cliente
graficos.sql: SELECT "Customer_Type" AS Type, COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS Total FROM customer_orders WHERE "Customer_Type" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Customer_Type" ORDER BY Total DESC

tablas.sub: Los pedidos con mayor monto total
tablas.sql: SELECT "Order_ID" AS "ID Pedido", "Customer_Name" AS "Cliente", "Branch" AS "Sucursal", "Product" AS "Producto", "Quantity" AS "Cantidad", "Unit_Price" AS "Precio Unit.", "Total" AS "Total", "Payment_Method" AS "Pago", "Status" AS "Estado" FROM customer_orders ORDER BY "Total" DESC LIMIT 10

modulos.descripcion: Análisis de tendencias temporales y patrones de venta

kpis.label: Rango de Fechas
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAST("Order_Date" AS DATE)) AS v FROM customer_orders

kpis.label: Ventas por Día
kpis.sql: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(daily_total), 0) AS v FROM (SELECT CAST("Order_Date" AS DATE) AS day, SUM("Total") AS daily_total FROM customer_orders GROUP BY day)

kpis.label: Mejor Día
kpis.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS v FROM customer_orders GROUP BY CAST("Order_Date" AS DATE) ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

graficos.sub: Evolución de ventas a lo largo del tiempo
graficos.sql: SELECT CAST("Order_Date" AS DATE) AS Date, COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS Total FROM customer_orders GROUP BY Date ORDER BY Date
SELECT "Status" AS Status, COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS Total, COUNT(*) AS Count FROM customer_orders WHERE "Status" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Status" ORDER BY Total DESC

modulos.descripcion: Desglose detallado por método de pago, productos y clientes

kpis.label: Métodos de Pago
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Payment_Method") AS v FROM customer_orders

kpis.label: Método de Pago Top
kpis.sql: SELECT "Payment_Method" AS v FROM customer_orders WHERE "Payment_Method" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Payment_Method" ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) DESC LIMIT 1
kpis.sub_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS v FROM customer_orders WHERE "Payment_Method" = (SELECT "Payment_Method" FROM customer_orders WHERE "Payment_Method" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Payment_Method" ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) DESC LIMIT 1)

kpis.label: Productos Únicos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Product") AS v FROM customer_orders

kpis.label: Clientes Únicos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Customer_Name") AS v FROM customer_orders

graficos.sub: Participación de ventas por método de pago
graficos.sql: SELECT "Payment_Method" AS Method, COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS Total FROM customer_orders WHERE "Payment_Method" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Payment_Method" ORDER BY Total DESC
SELECT "Product" AS Product, COALESCE(SUM("Quantity"), 0) AS Qty, COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS Total FROM customer_orders WHERE "Product" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Product" ORDER BY Qty DESC LIMIT 10

graficos.sub: Clientes con mayor volumen de compras
graficos.sql: SELECT "Customer_Name" AS Customer, COALESCE(SUM("Total"), 0) AS Total, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM customer_orders WHERE "Customer_Name" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "Customer_Name" ORDER BY Total DESC LIMIT 10

tablas.sub: Lista completa de pedidos con todos los detalles
tablas.sql: SELECT "Order_ID" AS "ID Pedido", "Customer_Name" AS "Cliente", "Customer_Type" AS "Tipo", "Branch" AS "Sucursal", "Order_Date" AS "Fecha", "Product" AS "Producto", "Product_Category" AS "Categoría", "Quantity" AS "Cant.", "Unit_Price" AS "P. Unit.", "Total" AS "Total", "Payment_Method" AS "Pago", "Status" AS "Estado" FROM customer_orders ORDER BY "Order_Date" DESC LIMIT 50
